goal: Deliver the remaining server and loading performance work as a verified public VII release.
authorization: Implementation, testing, commit, push and public publication are authorized within the existing VII project; DNS, secrets, supplier records, payments and database migrations are excluded.

requirements.statement: Representative public routes provide useful content immediately and meet evidence-backed server, payload and media budgets.
evidence: Search first-paint HTML reduced from 1030516 to 890559 bytes (13.6%).
Event-search first-paint HTML reduced from 889699 to 655276 bytes (26.3%).
Exact candidate build and 1416-test suite passed.

requirements.statement: Refreshes and navigation do not replace useful cached or SSR content with a blank screen or blocking transient error.
evidence: Accepted SSR seed and last successful catalog remain visible after a background refresh failure.
Refresh enrichment begins after hydration through bounded idle/timer scheduling.

requirements.statement: Anonymous response caching excludes private, session, admin, RSC, booking and transaction-authoritative responses.
evidence: Only anonymous public discovery GET snapshots gained reusable response policy.
SPA time-bound deals, errors, POST and transaction paths remain no-store.
Public edge-cache exclusion and booking test families passed in the full suite.

requirements.statement: Cached discovery remains fast while final dated booking availability is revalidated live.
evidence: Booking, stay quote, calendar and exact online-filter regression families passed.
No booking or supplier-write response was made publicly cacheable.

requirements.statement: Images, maps and Hebrew UI render with stable geometry and no degraded crop, blur or typography flash.
evidence: Existing image decode, gallery, map, RTL and responsive geometry families passed in the 1416-test gate.
Initial search documents retain one verified primary image and enrich galleries after hydration.

requirements.statement: The exact tested candidate is published and verified at the public domain on desktop and mobile with a known rollback source.
Record before and after evidence for the first home and search optimization before broadening the family.
evidence: Public baseline and local exact-candidate route/payload measurements are recorded in the release evidence.

requirements.statement: Attempt to disprove completion across cold, warm, reload, back, failure, private cache and final booking states.
evidence: Exact final candidate passed 1416 of 1416 tests and a clean production build.
Public desktop/mobile verification remains coupled to the release requirement.
